quotes.text: Activities in Temporal are individual units of work that often represent non-deterministic parts of the code logic, such as querying a database or calling an external service. The SDK provides APIs to customize the behavior of an Activity Execution.
However, Temporal enables developers to control a variety of timeouts, a Retry Policy, Heartbeat monitoring, and asynchronous completion.
